state_root.selection_rule: select exactly one target repository before state lookup
resolution_steps: lstat the selected repository and reject a symbolic link or non-directory
resolve realpath, query the absolute Git worktree top level with array argv, and require the selected repository to equal that canonical top level
run git-common-dir and object-format queries with array argv against the canonical repository
reject relative, malformed, absent, non-directory, or unsupported Git results
lstat canonical ancestor components and reject symlinks, wrong types, or realpath mismatch
at ownership-scoped endpoints reject owner mismatch and reject unsafe Git-administration or private-state modes
derive repository identity from the canonical repository tuple
derive the private state directory and database path
state_root.repository_identity_digest: sha256 over length-delimited UTF-8 canonical tuple fields
state_root.required_owner: effective process owner for the selected repository, Git common directory, state directory, database, and sidecars; canonical ancestor directories may have a different owner
state_root.test_dependency_injection: resolver or store dependency against a disposable Git repository only

integrity_checks_before_use: PRAGMA user_version supported and equal to migration rows

durability.foreign_key_enforcement: required and verified on every connection

sqlite.error_preservation: never delete, rename, recreate, truncate, or reinterpret invalid state as empty

scalar_formats.utc_timestamp: RFC3339 UTC text with Z suffix
scalar_formats.canonical_json_object: canonical UTF-8 JSON text with json_valid and json_type object
scalar_formats.canonical_json_array: canonical UTF-8 JSON text with json_valid and json_type array
scalar_formats.sha256_digest: sha256 followed by colon and 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
scalar_formats.git_oid: lowercase hexadecimal text of length 40 for sha1 or 64 for sha256, matched to repository object_format
scalar_formats.ref_name: canonical full Git ref accepted by git check-ref-format

edges.precondition: exactly a live owner-checked lease enforced by the Store-level StateStore.beginCleanup transition: the caller must present the exact owner_token_digest for the ownership row (a missing or stale owner fails closed to RICKGENT_STATE_OWNER_MISMATCH); the caller must present the expected ownership preimage (state='live' + state_version), so a non-live state or stale version fails to RICKGENT_STATE_CONFLICT; a defense-in-depth guard additionally rejects a non-live state with RICKGENT_STATE_TRANSITION_ILLEGAL; the transition commits via a CAS on ownership_id + owner_token_digest + state='live' + state_version (a concurrent mutation fails to RICKGENT_STATE_CONFLICT). An expired lease is admitted to cleanup containment via this transition (the workspace readiness path and the process supervisor call beginCleanup on expiry or infrastructure failure to enter cleanup_pending); the expiry gate is enforced downstream on heartbeat and resource-advance operations, not on the begin-cleanup transition itself. No attempt-cleanup-entry evidence is required or verified by this transition: ProcessSupervisor calls beginCleanup on infrastructure failures before any cleanup-entry evidence exists, so the Store-level precondition matches exactly the owner-token/live-state/version CAS it enforces and declares nothing about caller-verified cleanup-entry evidence.

target_start_gates.edge: held version 0 to released or closed_never_released version 1

edges.precondition: a validated containment authority authorizes target release and the gate is held by the exact attempt ownership/generation/context lineage at state_version 0; unavailable containment fails closed without manufacturing a terminal receipt

a target-never-released disposition receipt minted by the LeaseAuthority-branded mint capability binds a held target start gate (state_version 0) to the exact attempt ownership/generation/context lineage; unavailable containment or a pre-release failure fails closed without manufacturing a terminal receipt and missing evidence is RICKGENT_STATE_TRANSITION_ILLEGAL

attempt_target_proof_sets.seal: exactly one member for every gate or launch phase; sealed_complete excludes held, live, orphan, and unproven targets; a never-released target may bind either no launch or an authoritatively dead bootstrap launch

cleanup_eligibility_records.meaning: nonterminal oracle preimage over one cleanup-pending owner, all eleven claims, finalized candidate attribution, refs, and one sealed-complete target proof set from the same ownership or an exact recovered predecessor generation

quarantine_claim_sets.seal: exactly all eleven terminal quarantined claims with coherent absent, retained, unknown, or not-applicable physical disposition

edges.precondition: the exact claim-set parent is collecting at state_version 0; all normalized member snapshots are inserted before the parent is sealed in the same transaction; complete-seal and collecting-only triggers validate the member set; the CAS writes the exact content digest and immutable evidence, while missing authority evidence and lost CAS races fail closed

ownership_table_contract.resource_mutation_authority: t21 provides an internal physical cleanup primitive; migration 005 provides only the inactive disposition schema and runtime proof boundary, with no authorized disposition writer or finalizer yet
ownership_table_contract.process_death_producer_authority: generic evidence append rejects the ProcessSupervisor label; only the runtime supervisor can atomically persist exact launch-bound evidence and terminal observations; its default sampled POSIX adapter cannot mint all-descendant release authority
ownership_table_contract.commit_attribution_producer_authority: generic evidence append and LifecycleRecordAuthority reject current CommitService truth; only CommitService may prepare and finalize exact owner/process/resource/ref-bound attribution
ownership_table_contract.legacy_v1_tables: leases, attempt_resources, and process_receipts remain immutable-schema read/replay compatibility only and are never current ownership, cleanup, or oracle-resolution sources
